_help: Grand Line's renamed names. Part of the mod: every player of every later version sees them.
Each section maps an ORIGINAL name to the name shown. Delete a line to give the original name back.
island_npcs renames an NPC or enemy on one island only: { "Verdant Wilds": { "Bandit": "Lion" } }.
Only what players see changes: saves, quests and the mod's ids keep the original names.
